baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated verbs تُؤْمِنُونَ and تُجَاهِدُونَ lead into the route phrase and the paired instruments أَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust in God and the carried message establishes an orientation; striving then spends available capacity along a traversable course. Property and the whole self are not incidental donations but the external and personal media by which that trust takes a route, while خَيْر marks this as a comparative allocation.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supplies the inward orientation that can sustain costly movement.
A messenger carrying a message supplies the communicated object around which trust is organized.
Capacity spent under strain turns inward trust into exertion at its limit.
An extended traversable way gives the exertion direction and a means of reaching an end.
Acquired possessions supply the externally held capacity placed into the course.
The very self or whole identity makes the second contribution personal and comprehensive.
Choosing the better option frames the sequence as comparative reallocation rather than undirected loss.

changed_reading.before: Believe, then pay toward a religious struggle with money and life.
changed_reading.after: Entrust both holdings and whole identity to a message-directed route, spending capacity under strain because this is the better allocation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah moves from inward assent through effort and concrete holdings to the conditional إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Assent and hidden intent are otherwise interior. Making wealth and self available under effort lets that interior state emerge, while knowledge as a distinguishing mark makes the enacted pattern legible. The condition asks not only whether information is possessed but whether knowing has become present in a readable form.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the inward claim whose outward verification is at issue.
Inner thought and hidden intent identify what cannot be read until conduct exposes it.
Emergence into view or availability lets exertion function as disclosure of the hidden commitment.
Actually held wealth provides a concrete register in which assent can become observable.
Being or occurring in time makes the conditional concern an actual state of knowing, not an abstract label.
A distinguishing mark that points beyond itself lets enacted commitment serve as evidence of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The closing condition merely says that informed people know this teaching is good.
changed_reading.after: The prescribed availability of wealth and self is itself the visible mark by which claimed knowledge becomes an actual, readable state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The effort verb is immediately specified by the paired plurals بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair distinguishes stored, possessable capacity from embodied, breathing life. Striving reaches its limit by drawing on both registers; the branch of depletion makes the transfer costly, but the self branches keep it broader than a simple equation of money with death. The unit being converted is total human capacity.

activation_trace.role: Depletion through use or giving supplies the costly conversion applied to available resources.
Possessed wealth supplies stored and transferable capacity.
Breath leaving the body supplies the continuously embodied register of effort.
The living soul-self extends the contribution from breath and labor to life-bearing agency.
Desired beneficial good supplies the value test governing conversion rather than glorifying depletion itself.

changed_reading.before: Money and lives are two equivalent prices demanded by struggle.
changed_reading.after: Striving converts both stored possessions and embodied living capacity toward a desired good, without reducing the self to a second commodity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated rupture between utterance and action turns the two opening verbs of 61:11 into a repair sequence. Belief cannot remain voiced assent: the availability produced by striving, wealth, and self gives the utterance an enacted counterpart, with the severe aversion to mismatch supplying the pressure for congruence.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the verbal and inward claim that needs congruent action.
Speech brought out by the tongue isolates the stated commitment side of the mismatch.
The production of an actual deed supplies the missing counterpart to speech.
Severe aversion toward an ugly act makes speech-action incongruence causally urgent rather than cosmetic.
Making capacity visibly available lets striving serve as the enacted verification of assent.

structural_cues: 61:2-3 repeat the same saying/not-doing construction before 61:11 coordinates believing with striving.
The second-person plural address recurs, making 61:11 readable as an answer to the earlier communal mismatch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated speech/action contradiction and its severe evaluation; I infer that 61:11 repairs it by coupling assent to costly availability. A live alternative is that 61:2-3 only rebukes promise-breaking and does not define faith generally.

changed_reading.before: Faith is the first item in a list, followed by a separate duty of struggle.
changed_reading.after: Faith is revised into enacted assent: striving with holdings and self is the action that prevents belief from remaining contradicted speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Straight alignment, construction by joining parts, and compact fastening recast the plural wealth and selves as coordinated structural contributions. Their value lies not only in how much each person loses but in how separately held capacities become mutually load-bearing.

activation_trace.role: Alignment on a level line supplies the ordering relation among contributors.
Building by joining part to part turns separate persons and holdings into one operative structure.
Close packing and fastening supplies the cohesion by which aligned parts bear strain together.
Individually possessed wealth becomes one class of material contributed to the shared structure.
Whole selves become agentive structural parts rather than isolated objects of sacrifice.

structural_cues: 61:4 moves from a plural fighting body to rank, building, and compacted construction in one simile.
61:11 retains plural possessives on both wealth and selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aligned fighters and a building joined tightly; I infer that the plural resources of 61:11 are valuable through coordination and mutual support. The live alternative is that 61:4 describes only battlefield discipline, leaving 61:11 as individual expenditure.

changed_reading.before: Each believer independently spends possessions and risks a private self.
changed_reading.after: Plural holdings and selves are construction material only in a social sense: alignment joins them into a mutually supporting body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places disclosed knowledge before deliberate deviation and then a turning of hearts. Knowledge therefore does not automatically stabilize direction. In 61:11, knowing is live only when it steers capacity onto the route; the final condition tests aligned orientation rather than informational possession.

activation_trace.role: A fact becoming clear supplies knowledge that is already present before conduct diverges.
Deviation from straightness supplies the failed steering that knowledge alone did not prevent.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the reinforcing reversal that follows chosen deviation.
The traversed route gives knowledge a directional field in which alignment or deviation can appear.
Knowledge as a guiding mark makes correct allocation evidence of orientation rather than mere awareness.

structural_cues: In 61:5, knowing precedes the sequence they deviated, then God turned their hearts.
The conditional knowledge clause closes 61:11 only after the route and both forms of expenditure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowledge coexisting with deviation and a subsequent heart-turning; I infer that knowing in 61:11 must function as steering to count. A live alternative is that the closing condition remains a conventional rhetorical appeal to obvious benefit.

changed_reading.before: If you understand the proposition, you can recognize that the commanded exchange is better.
changed_reading.after: Knowing is a directional performance: it is real when wealth and self remain steered onto the acknowledged route despite the possibility of deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Messenger language appears in a temporal relay: a message confirms what is before, announces one coming after, and crosses the interval between parties. Trusting the messenger in 61:11 can therefore recruit the addressees into transmission, with their effort and resources carrying continuity forward rather than merely acknowledging an office.

activation_trace.role: Succession in batches supplies a relay image for messengers appearing in sequence.
Fulfilling a promise in deed makes confirmation an active carrying-forward rather than verbal agreement.
A connection standing between parties supplies the linkage across the prophetic sequence.
After in relation to before supplies the temporal handoff within the relay.
Being sent forth and released gives the focus messenger a vector that can continue through responsive agents.

structural_cues: 61:6 coordinates confirming what is before with announcing a messenger after.
61:11 joins trust in the messenger directly to resource-bearing exertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies before/after succession, confirmation, and repeated messenger language; I infer that exertion by the addressees becomes a medium of onward transmission. A live alternative is that the sequence only establishes prophetic chronology and authorizes no relay role for the audience.

changed_reading.before: Believe that the named messenger is authoritative, then undertake a separate struggle.
changed_reading.after: Trust in the messenger places the audience inside a relay, where effort, holdings, and selves carry the message's continuity forward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mouths attempt to cool a flame-like light, but completion is explicitly assigned to God. This limits an instrumental reading of 61:11: wealth and selves do not fuel a fragile divine project. Their exposure is participatory alignment within a completion whose efficacy does not depend on their supply.

activation_trace.role: A flame becoming still and embers cooling supplies the opponents' intended interruption.
Illumination supplies the process that opposition tries to terminate but cannot own.
The mouth opening in speech makes hostile utterance the local attempted mechanism of extinguishing.
A thing reaching completion assigns the decisive endpoint beyond the contributors' capacity.
Capacity spent under strain remains real participation without becoming the cause that guarantees completion.

structural_cues: 61:8 opposes an attempted purpose clause with the declaration that God completes the light.
61:11 names God twice around the path while assigning possessions and selves to the addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted extinguishing and divine completion; I infer a corrective arrow that makes human expenditure participation rather than fuel for divine success. A live alternative is that 61:11 specifies the ordinary human means through which that promised completion occurs.

changed_reading.before: God's cause needs believers to keep it alive by supplying wealth and lives.
changed_reading.after: Believers expose their capacity in alignment with a completion guaranteed beyond them; expenditure is participation, not indispensable fuel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle direction toward a route, truth made established and visible, and emergence into view converge with the focus branches of path, disclosure, and marking. The effort of 61:11 can make guidance publicly legible by embodying it in observable allocations, not only defend a private conviction.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a road and truth supplies the directional content to be made legible.
Establishing and showing what is true supplies public verification rather than private possession.
Emergence and disclosure supply the public surface on which guidance becomes readable.
Making something available or visible lets exertion disclose the order it serves.
A distinguishing sign turns resource allocation into a marker pointing to the professed truth.

structural_cues: 61:9 gives the sending of the messenger a purpose of making the true order appear over the whole field.
61:11 immediately renders commitment in observable plural resources.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, established truth, and appearance; I infer that visible allocation in 61:11 is one way truth becomes publicly legible. The materially live alternative is the stronger sense of ascendancy rather than disclosure, retained separately below.

changed_reading.before: The ayah prescribes costly loyalty whose value may remain inward or private.
changed_reading.after: The allocation of holdings and selves is a public sign-system through which guidance becomes socially visible and verifiable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Obedience as an ordering relation, strenuous resistance carried despite aversion, and appearance as ascendancy make the route a contested social field. On this reading, the total capacity of 61:11 is mobilized because rival regimes of allegiance cannot all organize the field at once.

activation_trace.role: Hardship borne by one who resists supplies the friction against which the project advances.
Obedience and submission supply the competing social order at stake.
Rising above and prevailing supplies the stronger ascendant relation among rival orders.
Expenditure of full capacity under strain supplies mobilization within the contested field.
The traversed course supplies a sustained program rather than a single private act.

structural_cues: 61:9 places one dīn over dīn in its entirety and retains opponents' aversion.
61:11 follows with plural mobilization of both wealth and selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival obedience orders, resistance, and ascendancy; I infer that 61:11 mobilizes capacity in a conflict over what organizes collective life. The materially live alternative is non-coercive public manifestation, retained as its own model rather than merged here.

changed_reading.before: Striving is chiefly an individual's costly proof of sincerity.
changed_reading.after: Striving mobilizes total capacity in a contested field where rival structures of allegiance seek to order collective life.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sign indicates a trade seeking gain, and that trade separates its participants from painful exposure. Because 61:11 itself names wealth and calls its allocation better, the transaction can be read as a portfolio reversal: what seems retained is exposed to loss, while what is committed to the route is moved out of the harmful position.

activation_trace.role: Indication by a sign makes the following trade a disclosed route rather than an opaque demand.
Commerce seeking profit supplies the explicit calculus of putting resources at risk for return.
Deliverance by separation supplies the trade's movement out of a harmful exposure.
Painful punishment supplies the loss position from which the transaction separates its participants.
Possessed wealth makes the transaction materially concrete and exposes the illusion that retention is risk-free.
Selecting the better option supplies the comparative decision rule for reallocating both holdings and self.

structural_cues: 61:10 poses a question about a trade; 61:11 answers it with two verbs and two committed resources.
The comparative خَيْر in 61:11 evaluates the transaction before its outcomes are enumerated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trade, gain-seeking, deliverance, and painful exposure; I infer a portfolio reversal in which non-commitment is also a risky position. A live alternative is a direct price-for-reward exchange with no revaluation of retained assets.

changed_reading.before: The believers pay God with wealth and lives and receive a larger reward.
changed_reading.after: The ayah discloses a reversal of risk: committing holdings and self is the better reallocation because apparent retention remains exposed to the deeper loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's depletion and exposure are followed by covering, entry into an enclosed garden, continuing flow, and inhabitation. The sequence transforms the material logic: finite stocks and embodied effort leave private possession, but the promised destination is sustained circulation within a protected dwelling rather than mere replacement of one stockpile by another.

activation_trace.role: Resources drained through use or giving supply the finite-stock side of the transformation.
A cover that preserves what it shields reverses the exposure involved in costly commitment.
Entry into an interior supplies a change of environment, not merely an external payment.
A garden enclosed by vegetation supplies protected abundance around the entrants.
Continuing provision and giving supplies circulation that does not exhaust like a private stock.
Inhabiting a dwelling turns the outcome into durable belonging rather than a momentary payout.

structural_cues: 61:12 continues the answer with a chain of covering, entering, flowing, and dwelling.
The finite possessions and selves of 61:11 stand immediately before recurrent water and stable habitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies depletion in the focus and protected entry, continuing flow, and dwelling afterward; I infer a shift from private stock to sustained circulation and belonging. A live alternative is that 61:12 simply lists rewards with no material reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Finite goods and life are surrendered now and replaced later by a larger private reward.
changed_reading.after: Finite private capacity is released into a route whose answering image is protected entry, continuing provision, and durable inhabitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: After protected gardens, an 'other' loved outcome is named as aid and a near opening. The comparative good of 61:11 therefore spans at least two temporal horizons. It does not require disowning immediate desire; it orders love by coupling deferred transformation with a proximate opening.

activation_trace.role: Love abiding in the heart legitimates a desired nearer outcome within the larger calculus.
Another item after a first supplies a second outcome without erasing the preceding one.
Aid that also makes apparent supplies a socially experienced return in the nearer field.
An obstruction opening into a wider entrance supplies release and new practical possibility.
Temporal nearness places this opening on a horizon distinct from the preceding dwelling.
Choosing the better option coordinates the two horizons rather than opposing worldly and deferred good absolutely.

structural_cues: 61:13 begins with 'another' after 61:12's extended outcome and explicitly says it is loved.
Aid and a near opening form a compact second horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior outcome followed by another loved, near one; I infer that the 'better' allocation of 61:11 coordinates deferred and proximate goods. A live alternative is that 'another' is merely an extra promise and does not reshape the value grammar of 61:11.

changed_reading.before: The better choice rejects present desire in exchange for an exclusively deferred good.
changed_reading.after: The better choice orders multiple loves across time, holding transformed future dwelling together with aid and opening in the near field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to become helpers is answered by a collective 'we'; clustered groups then differentiate, one is strengthened, and it becomes visible. This recasts the selves of 61:11 as agents constituted through a support relation. Their contribution is not self-erasure but becoming a network able to bear and manifest the message.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into visibility supplies the resulting public state of the supported group.
Aid joined with making apparent supplies the reciprocal role around which the collective forms.
Undertaking responsibility for another turns 'be' into assumption of a sustaining role.
The disciple as helper supplies a relational identity defined by active support.
A group clustered together supplies the social units that can split and act differently.
Strength that reinforces supplies the enabling force by which one group can become manifest.
Whole selves supply agents capable of assuming support roles rather than disposable units.

structural_cues: 61:14 repeats helpers of God three times, includes the response 'we', then narrates two groups and support.
The plural possessive selves of 61:11 anticipates the later collective role command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a command to become helpers, a collective self-declaration, group differentiation, reinforcement, and visibility; I infer that offering selves means becoming a support network. A live alternative is that the passage recruits only a combat alliance and does not generalize to social constitution.

changed_reading.before: Believers contribute individual selves to a cause external to them.
changed_reading.after: By contributing whole selves, believers become a reciprocal support body through which the message gains durable social form and visibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the kinetic swimming/running branch of the context's tasbīḥ rather than treating it only as praise. It remains anchored in the focus's effort and traversable route; downstream prose should present it as a spatial analogy, not as the lexical translation of either verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines strenuous capacity with movement in a سبيل, while 61:1 supplies a whole-cosmos motion cue.

activation_trace.role: Running or swimming supplies a pervasive kinetic current for the context's opening praise.
A traversable extended way anchors that current to the focus's explicit route.
Capacity spent under strain makes joining the current disciplined movement rather than passive drift.

changed_reading.before: Striving pushes against an inert world to establish an isolated religious project.
changed_reading.after: Striving can be imagined as disciplined entry into a cosmic current already moving in praise, with the route channeling rather than originating that motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads أَنفُس through breath and places embodied breath beside hostile mouths attempting to cool light. The focus word, the mouth, light, and extinguishing branches keep the analogy anchored; downstream prose should qualify it as a material contrast about voice and embodied expenditure, not claim that أَنفُس simply means speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus offers أَنفُس under exertion; the nearby context locates attempted extinguishing in mouths.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body makes the offered self materially continuous with voice and exertion.
A mouth opened in speech supplies the opposing use of embodied breath.
Cooling flame and stilling embers supplies what hostile breath tries to accomplish.
Illumination supplies the contested medium around which contrary expenditures of breath become visible.

changed_reading.before: Offering selves means an abstract willingness to sacrifice life.
changed_reading.after: Offering selves may also include spending breath, voice, and embodied presence against speech that tries to extinguish, while completion remains beyond either mouth's control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes commercial deliverance through the branch of elevated safe ground. It remains anchored in the explicit trade frame, the focus's route, comparative choice, and whole self; downstream prose should call it an abductive evacuation model, not a direct gloss of تِجَارَة or تُنجِيكُم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names a traversable route, possessed wealth, whole selves, and a better choice as the answer to the preceding trade question.

activation_trace.role: Trade seeking gain supplies the decision under risk that initiates the spatial model.
Elevated land that escapes surrounding danger supplies the destination of reallocation.
The extended traversable way supplies the evacuation route toward safer ground.
Choosing the better option supplies the judgment that staying put is not neutral.
The whole self makes the move existential rather than a transfer of money alone.

changed_reading.before: The trade metaphor prices obedience and promises profit.
changed_reading.after: The trade can be carried as an evacuation map: move holdings and whole selves along the indicated route because the apparently stationary position is the exposed one.

strongest_changes: Faith became enacted congruence rather than a list item before struggle.
Plural wealth and selves became coordinated, load-bearing social capacity.
Knowing became steering and visible marking, since disclosed knowledge can coexist with deviation.
Trade became a reversal of risk and later a movement from finite stock toward protected flow and dwelling.
Public manifestation and ascendant social order remained distinct coexisting readings.
Offering selves culminated in becoming a reciprocal support network rather than self-erasure.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly converted abstract nouns into mechanisms: speech demanded action, private resources became architecture, knowledge became steering, messengerhood became relay, expenditure was bounded by divine completion, and sacrifice opened into flow, multiple temporal horizons, and collective support. Branch-distant breath, current, and high-ground models remained contained but live.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ظ ه ر in 61:9 should weight public disclosure or social supremacy more heavily.
Whether the trade frame primarily denotes exchange, risk reallocation, or rescue from an exposed position.
How far messenger succession licenses an audience relay rather than only prophetic chronology.
Whether the cosmic-current and breath/mouth activations can inform commentary without being mistaken for lexical glosses.
